title: Are squishy toys safe? – level 1
paragraphs: Many kids love playing with squishy toys. Scientists test some of these toys to see if they are safe. They find that one toy has too much of one chemical. This chemical can hurt children.
Also, if squishies stay in a hot car for a long time, they can break. Hot liquid may come out. This can hurt a child’s skin.
The store takes the bad toy away. They give money back to parents. Experts tell families to check toy labels and keep the toys away from hot places like cars.

words.d: soft, not hard when you touch it
a substance which flows, like water or gel
a piece of paper on a product which gives information about it
